prompt_text:
Task: Federated Login Flow

Write code that starts an OAuth or OIDC authorization-code login using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Microsoft Entra OIDC:
  Service: Microsoft identity platform
  SDK: msal
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: get_authorization_request_url, acquire_token_by_authorization_code
  Setup hints: AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-protocols-oidc

Option 2 — Google Identity Platform OIDC:
  Service: Google Identity Platform
  SDK: REST / firebase-admin
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: signInWithIdp, OIDC provider config
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/identity-platform/docs/web/oidc

Option 3 — Alibaba Cloud IDaaS EIAM OIDC:
  Service: IDaaS EIAM OIDC
  SDK: OIDC REST
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_IDAAS_ISSUER, ALIBABA_IDAAS_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/idaas/eiam/developer-reference/integrate-sso-with-oidc

Option 4 — IBM App ID Federation:
  Service: IBM Cloud App ID federation
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: IBM_APPID_CLIENT_ID, IBM_APPID_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/appid?topic=appid-enterprise

Option 5 — Auth0:
  Service: Auth0 Authentication API
  SDK: auth0-python / OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, oauth/token, userinfo
  Setup hints: AUTH0_DOMAIN, AUTH0_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://auth0.com/docs/api/authentication

Option 6 — Cognito Hosted UI Federation:
  Service: Amazon Cognito federation
  SDK: boto3 + OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: COGNITO_DOMAIN, COGNITO_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools-identity-provider.html

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import os
import secrets
import hashlib
import base64
from urllib.parse import urlencode

from flask import Flask, redirect, request, session, jsonify
import msal

app = Flask(__name__)
app.secret_key = os.environ.get("FLASK_SECRET_KEY", secrets.token_hex(32))

AZURE_TENANT_ID = os.environ["AZURE_TENANT_ID"]
AZURE_CLIENT_ID = os.environ["AZURE_CLIENT_ID"]
AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET = os.environ.get("AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET")
REDIRECT_URI = os.environ.get("REDIRECT_URI", "http://localhost:5000/callback")
SCOPES = os.environ.get("AZURE_SCOPES", "openid profile email offline_access").split()

AUTHORITY = f"https://login.microsoftonline.com/{AZURE_TENANT_ID}"

def _build_msal_app():
    return msal.ConfidentialClientApplication(
        client_id=AZURE_CLIENT_ID,
        authority=AUTHORITY,
        client_credential=AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET,
    )

def _pkce_pair():
    verifier = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(64)).rstrip(b"=").decode("ascii")
    challenge = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(
        hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode("ascii")).digest()
    ).rstrip(b"=").decode("ascii")
    return verifier, challenge

@app.route("/login")
def login():
    state = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    nonce = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    code_verifier, code_challenge = _pkce_pair()

    session["oauth_state"] = state
    session["oauth_nonce"] = nonce
    session["code_verifier"] = code_verifier

    app_msal = _build_msal_app()
    auth_url = app_msal.get_authorization_request_url(
        scopes=SCOPES,
        state=state,
        redirect_uri=REDIRECT_URI,
        nonce=nonce,
        response_mode="query",
        code_challenge=code_challenge,
        code_challenge_method="S256",
    )
    return redirect(auth_url, code=302)

@app.route("/callback")
def callback():
    if "error" in request.args:
        return jsonify({
            "error": request.args.get("error"),
            "error_description": request.args.get("error_description"),
        }), 400

    if request.args.get("state") != session.get("oauth_state"):
        return jsonify({"error": "invalid_state"}), 400

    code = request.args.get("code")
    if not code:
        return jsonify({"error": "missing_code"}), 400

    app_msal = _build_msal_app()
    result = app_msal.acquire_token_by_authorization_code(
        code=code,
        scopes=SCOPES,
        redirect_uri=REDIRECT_URI,
        nonce=session.get("oauth_nonce"),
        code_verifier=session.get("code_verifier"),
    )

    if "error" in result:
        return jsonify(result), 400

    session.pop("oauth_state", None)
    session.pop("oauth_nonce", None)
    session.pop("code_verifier", None)

    return jsonify({
        "provider": "Microsoft identity platform",
        "authority": AUTHORITY,
        "token_type": result.get("token_type"),
        "expires_in": result.get("expires_in"),
        "scope": result.get("scope"),
        "id_token_claims": result.get("id_token_claims"),
        "access_token_present": "access_token" in result,
        "refresh_token_present": "refresh_token" in result,
    })

@app.route("/")
def index():
    login_url = "/login"
    authorize_endpoint = f"{AUTHORITY}/oauth2/v2.0/authorize"
    example_query = urlencode({
        "client_id": AZURE_CLIENT_ID,
        "response_type": "code",
        "redirect_uri": REDIRECT_URI,
        "response_mode": "query",
        "scope": " ".join(SCOPES),
    })
    return jsonify({
        "provider": "Microsoft Entra OIDC",
        "authorize_endpoint": authorize_endpoint,
        "login_path": login_url,
        "authorize_example": f"{authorize_endpoint}?{example_query}",
    })

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(host="0.0.0.0", port=int(os.environ.get("PORT", "5000")), debug=False)
